explanations.11: The || return 1 means "if the _git_staged_diff command fails, stop this function immediately and report failure to whoever called it".
explanations.24: The print -n command outputs text without a newline at the end, so the user's keypress appears on the same line as the question.
explanations.26: read -k1 means "wait for the user to type exactly one character (a single keypress), don't wait for Enter", which is why the answer appears instantly.
explanations.30: The | symbol here means "or", so y|Y matches either lowercase or uppercase y — whichever the user types.
explanations.31: The -e flag tells git to open your text editor so you can modify the message before committing, while -m still provides a starting message.
